entities.how_described: 一家 25 年历史的小型量化基金,身处严格监管行业,却让公司每个人都有以本人身份运行的云端智能体。

entities.name: Claude Code
entities.how_described: 2025 年 6 月 GA 后推动智能体普及的工具,但受限于 CLI 且只能本地运行;本集还讲了如何 deny 它原生的 WebSearch/WebFetch 工具来强制网络访问走内部索引。

evidence.quote: So back in June 2025, you know, Claude Code GA and all that stuff, people started using agents through the local computer, your local machine, and it's very powerful, but one, it was CLI-constrained, and two, it was localized, right?

entities.name: Kubernetes
entities.how_described: 本集说它是现成的地基:Kubernetes 集群里每个区域、每个用户都有专属命名空间,其中所有东西都以该用户身份运行,智能体直接部署进去即可。

evidence.quote: If you don't, I would encourage investing in it, which is that, you know, you can have a Kubernetes cluster.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 提示词注入 (prompt injection)
entities.how_described: 开放网络访问带来的不可信内容回流风险之一;本集说因为一切网络访问保持在 VPC 内部,提示词注入风险被大大降低。

evidence.quote: And prompt injection, just malware and vulnerabilities are all big risks there.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: But the prompt injection risk is far reduced because everything still remains internal.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 可观测性 (observability)
entities.how_described: 本集用 trace ID 式传播做类比:让每个智能体持续向 header 附加标记,不仅区分人做还是智能体做,还能重放导致最终结果的整条行动链,获得远超纯身份验证的可观测性。

evidence.quote: You've all done this in deterministic code, making sure that your observability stack propagates through a trace ID through disparate systems.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: So the index certainly lags, but we get a ton more observability by just using that tagging primitive versus the actual just pure identity verification.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: MCP
entities.how_described: 本集把它当作强制填充 header、重定向网络访问的现有控制手段之一(与 HTTP 客户端、skills 并列)。

evidence.quote: Instead, we use the redirection going through MCP CLI and actual client code using the supported paths, skills, whatever, to make sure that whenever someone does need the capabilities of web access, it goes through that web grounding cached index.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 推理 (inference)
entities.how_described: 问答中提到:对于企业的大量 token 使用和推理,自己管理的本地模型可能是最终方向,因为成本、模型弃用与前沿实验室发新模型带来的性能波动。

evidence.quote: And I think local in the sense that we manage ourselves is probably where we eventually want to go for a lot of our token use and inference.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01
